title: The Android core benchmark passed ten Tamil journeys in 165
question: What did the recorded experiment show?
workload: The Android core benchmark passed ten Tamil journeys in 165
method: Original decision-log entry and measurements are preserved verbatim below.
finding: The Android core benchmark passed ten Tamil journeys in 165.8–169.8 s across three fresh runners. One runner passed ten LeetCode journeys in 213.4 s. Testing the five ordered candidates per section fits the observed warm budget. The [native coverage audit](2026-11-25-native-learner-suites.md) records results and remaining races.
